question: What is the balance of trade of a country?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Difference between imports and exports**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The balance of trade of a country is the **difference between its imports and exports**.
 
• If a country exports more than it imports, it has a trade surplus; if it imports more than it exports, it has a trade deficit.
